title: Juliet Test Suite for Java v1.3 (subset)
description: NIST SARD's synthetic Java suite: each test case has a bad() method that contains the weakness and good*() methods that look similar and are safe (the multi-file variants split these into _bad and _good classes). Labels are derived from that naming when the suite is prepared. A sample of each selected weakness class, scored per CWE: a bad method is a defect, a good method must stay quiet, and findings for other CWEs are ignored. Public domain, but about 100 MB, so fetched and hash-pinned rather than vendored: run the prepare script.

source.licence: Public domain (US government work); fetched at prep time into a gitignored cache
